sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR. A temporary deviation needs Stellantis approval, requested through the supplier portal, before any shipment. No document in force already grants that approval. PRC-DEV-007 only records an unrelated past deviation, DEV-2025-019 for HS-040. The request (1,800 pieces, 5 weeks, 100% hole inspection) is within the PRC-DEV-007 limits, so there is no deviation-limit finding. Alluminio B holds AP-0311 for BR-220, so there is no source-release finding either. The 2026-11-05 email claiming that 6061-T6 billet from Meccanica C is acceptable for BR-220 is outdated, because it follows drawing Rev B. That email is not part of this proposal.
